observations.behavior: Adds account-level endpoint configurations for team members and roles, including shared primary keys and base URL.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse ingestion to fetch team membership and role metadata from the account host rather than the Uptime subdomain, supporting account-scoped identity and permission data.

observations.behavior: Adds error messages for 401/403 on the account host and a 422 for team-scoped token requirements.

observations.posthog_connection: Provides actionable diagnostics when warehouse ingestion fails due to account-level or team-scoped token mismatches, distinguishing account and team token requirements.

observations.behavior: Adds a merge-only configuration for fan-out children that lack server-side time filters, preventing duplicate row ingestion.
observations.posthog_connection: Supports incremental ingestion for nested collections without server-side pagination, avoiding redundant row writes and preserving warehouse consistency.
